headline: Strong execution; Order pipeline remains intact

highlights: Order book stood at INR687.2bn providing healthy execution visibility, with key programs including Electronic Fuses, LCA MK1A, LR-SAM, BMP-2 upgrades, Ashwini Radar and EW Suites for Mi-17 accounting for ~INR176bn.
Management reiterated FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15%+, EBITDA margin of ~28% and minimum order inflows of INR250bn, excluding QRSAM (INR300bn).
The ~INR200bn NGC opportunity is expected to translate into staggered orders from GSL and GRSE, largely by FY27-end.
Management has proactively initiated QRSAM-related activities to accelerate execution and mitigate potential delays.
valuation: Management aims to ensure a more evenly distributed execution schedule across the year, avoiding quarterly concentration of deliveries, while targeting on-time execution or delivery 1-2 months ahead of committed timelines.

Bharat Electronics PL Research is also available on www.plindia.com, Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters and Factset Institutional Equities | 4 Other programs: BEL and L&T have formed a 50:50 consortium for AMCA, with technical evaluation of the submitted bid expected over the next 2-3 months and price bid potentially opening before FY27-end.
Cyber security: BEL has established a separate Network and Cyber Security SBU at Bengaluru, targeting civilian and critical infrastructure applications.
